description: The line plot, titled "Ablation Study on HateXplain," illustrates the performance of different model variants on three evaluation metrics—Precision, Recall, and F1-score—measured as percentages on the y-axis. The x-axis displays four distinct model configurations: "Model (Ours)," "w/o Prompt," "w/o Augmentation," and "w/o Attention & Augmentation." The legend indicates that the purple line with circular markers represents Precision, the blue line with circular markers represents Recall, and the brown line with circular markers represents the F1-score. The model (Ours) achieves the highest performance across all three metrics, with Precision at 65.45%, Recall at 65.78%, and F1-score at 65.56%. When the prompt is removed (w/o Prompt), all metrics drop significantly, with Precision at 61.06%, Recall at 59.64%, and F1-score at 60.16%. The "w/o Augmentation" variant shows a recovery in performance, with Precision at 62.22%, Recall at 62.63%, and F1-score at 62.75%. The "w/o Attention & Augmentation" variant shows a further decline, with Precision at 64.06%, Recall at 59.17%, and F1-score at 57.74%. The F1-score consistently remains the lowest of the three metrics across all model variants.
